commit 60b02909b7bfea68cdcc6a2d90acbd4c3e52916d
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Jun 18 13:35:03 2026 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Thu Jun 18 13:35:03 2026 +1200

    Bug 2048446 - Port bug 2010557: Update security/sandbox/chromium/ to Chromium 144. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD
    OS_LIBS needs updating.

diff --git a/mail/app/moz.build b/mail/app/moz.build
index 9bf4490991c..49cacb3bfea 100644
--- a/mail/app/moz.build
+++ b/mail/app/moz.build
@@ -31,9 +31,14 @@ if CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
     RCINCLUDE = "splash.rc"
     DEFINES["MOZ_THUNDERBIRD"] = True
 
+    OS_LIBS += [
+        "advapi32",
+        "shell32",
+        "ntdll",
+    ]
+
     # Don't build thunderbird.exe with CETCOMPAT, because we need to be able to
     # only enable it for processes that are not using JIT in xul.dll.
-
     LINK_FLAGS["CETCOMPAT"] = []
 
 if CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "Darwin":
@@ -48,18 +53,15 @@ if CONFIG["MOZ_SANDBOX"] and CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
         "/security/sandbox/chromium-shim",
     ]
 
-    OS_LIBS += [
-        "version",
-    ]
-
     USE_LIBS += [
         "sandbox_s",
     ]
 
     OS_LIBS += [
-        "advapi32",
-        "winmm",
+        "shlwapi",
         "user32",
+        "version",
+        "winmm",
     ]
 
     DELAYLOAD_DLLS += [
@@ -67,11 +69,6 @@ if CONFIG["MOZ_SANDBOX"] and CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
         "user32.dll",
     ]
 
-if CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
-    OS_LIBS += [
-        "ntdll",
-    ]
-
 if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] in ("msvc", "clang-cl"):
     # Always enter a Windows program through wmain, whether or not we're
     # a console application.
title: Bug 2048446 - Port bug 2010557: Update security/sandbox/chromium/ to Chromium 144. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD OS_LIBS needs updating.
